NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow wtf.ai to use your location while navigating.
NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow wtf.ai to connect to your OBD-II adapter to read vehicle speed.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Allow wtf.ai to read the phone's motion sensors, to follow the car when satellite positioning is jammed.
